description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walaswewa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310085
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
